description: Defines a Qt-based adapter class for Redis asynchronous context integration with Qt's socket notifier system.

classes.name: RedisQtAdapter
classes.description: A Qt QObject-based adapter for Redis asynchronous context, managing socket notifications for read/write events.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Associates a redisAsyncContext with the adapter and sets callback functions.

methods.name: addRead
methods.description: Creates a QSocketNotifier for read events.

methods.name: addWrite
methods.description: Creates a QSocketNotifier for write events.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes both read and write socket notifiers.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Slot that handles read events, calling redisAsyncHandleRead.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Slot that handles write events, calling redisAsyncHandleWrite.
